description: One engine on the knowledge base's roster: a provider and a model its Inference document names, and the jobs it is declared to serve. An engine is not a principal: the work is done by the worker that runs it, under the worker's own account, which names the engine it used on each write. The roster carries no inference limits: the services that hold the inference credentials report those (InferenceLimitsResult).

serves.description: The jobs this engine is declared to serve (from the knowledge base's workers.* config sections), as a claim would name them. Absent for an engine declared only under actor roles.
